title: Child labor crime.
bodyText: Any person, other than the minor employee, who knowingly violates any provision of this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: §390-7  Child labor crime.  Any person, other than the minor employee, who knowingly violates any provision of this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1969, c 162, pt of §2; am L 2003, c 61, §6]
